Huawei 10G SFP+ Module 850nm (Multimode) 0.3km – High-Speed Optical Transceiver

Enhance your network with the Huawei 10G SFP+ 850nm Multimode Transceiver, designed for short-range, high-speed data transmission up to 300 meters over OM3 multimode fiber. Operating at an 850nm wavelength, this compact and hot-swappable module delivers 10Gbps data rates, making it ideal for data centers, enterprise switches, storage networks, and high-performance computing environments.

Built to SFP+ MSA standards, this transceiver ensures stable performance, low latency, and energy efficiency. It features a duplex LC connector and is fully compatible with a wide range of Huawei networking equipment.

Key Features:

  • Data Rate: 10Gbps
  • Wavelength: 850nm
  • Transmission Distance: 0.3km (300 meters) over multimode fiber
  • Connector Type: LC Duplex
  • Form Factor: SFP+
  • Applications: 10G Ethernet, Fibre Channel, enterprise LANs
  • Compatibility: Huawei switches, routers, and servers
